review.posthog_relevance: Adds regression tests and metadata assertions for Fly.io warehouse ingestion, potentially preventing future regressions in warehouse ingestion.
review.reason: The chunk is dominated by documentation and metadata, but P1.F5.H7 and P1.F6.H2 contain executable Python changes. P1.F5.H7 removes a potentially brittle assertion and adds a parameterized test for warehouse ingestion. P1.F6.H2 removes a schema assertion and adds an import. These are substantive, bounded correctness and reliability improvements. No tier assignment is made for P1.F4
review.uncertainty: The chunk lacks implementation and tests for the fan-out and secret redaction configuration, and P1.F6.H1 lacks surrounding context. The tier is assigned based on the available executable hunks, not the complete implementation. No tier assignment is made for P1.F4, P1.F5.H7, P1.F6.H2.
